summary: Frontend-only re-test of F3 reservation lifecycle on the public preview URL (admin@stayos.local). ALL 3 requested scenarios PASS. (1) REGRESSION FIXED - Edit save works: /reservations/5d4f398d-9c37-4239-87e3-d7aa481665b3/edit (HS260817-01004, Karan Gill, Deluxe, 20->22 Dec 2026, CONFIRMED) -> changed Special requests + Internal notes -> Save Changes fired PATCH /properties/:pid/reservations/:id returning 200 (no 400 VALIDATION_ERROR), green toast 'Booking updated / Booking saved successfully.', app navigated back to the detail page, and both edits are reflected there (Notes card 'T1 notes 1786997159', Special requests 'Late checkout 1786997225') and persist after reload. useBookings.updateBooking now strips status/source/ratePlanId as intended. (2) Cancel flow: data-testid='cancel-booking-trigger' opens the 'Cancel booking?' modal; data-testid='cancel-confirm-button' fires PATCH .../cancel -> 200, green toast 'Booking cancelled / The booking has been cancelled.', badge flips Confirmed -> Cancelled, read-only 'Cancelled booking' alert shows, and the Activity card now reads exactly 'Booking cancelled. Any held room and inventory have been released.' - the stale 'Booking confirmed. Room assignment pending.' sentence is GONE. (3) Confirm re-check on PENDING 059be554-5c0e-4527-b236-42a4984ccb67 (HSDEMO-0012): data-testid='confirm-booking-button' -> PATCH .../confirm 200, toast 'Booking confirmed / The booking is confirmed. Assign a room to continue to check-in.', badge -> Confirmed, button unmounts. Two pre-existing cosmetic issues from iteration_15 are still open (duplicate 'Check-in not available yet' block; cancelled booking still shows a 'Payment Due' chip + 'Collect during check-in after ID verification.' guidance).
